questions.stem: What is the larger root of λ² − 13λ + 36 = 0?
questions.explain: Factor as (λ − 4)(λ − 9) = 0, so the roots are 4 and 9, and the larger one is 9.

questions.stem: Let g(x) = x² and f(x) = √x. What is f(g(−3))?
questions.explain: The inside call gives g(−3) = 9, and then f(9) = 3. The root of a square is the positive value |−3| = 3, not −3.

questions.stem: Let $A=\begin{pmatrix}5&0\\0&2\end{pmatrix}$ and $v=\begin{pmatrix}1\\0\end{pmatrix}$. Then $Av=\lambda v$ for some number λ. What is λ?
questions.explain: Av = (5, 0) = 5·(1, 0), so v is scaled by 5 and λ = 5.

questions.stem: Q is an orthogonal matrix and x is a vector of length 7. What is the length of Qx?
questions.explain: An orthogonal matrix preserves lengths, because (Qx)ᵀ(Qx) = xᵀQᵀQx = xᵀx. So the length stays 7.
